description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Cantor Fitzgerald Technology Markets, LLC is hiring an Associate, Software Developer to design, develop, and maintain web applications and backend services supporting capital markets and fixed income. The role collaborates with business and operations teams, integrates APIs and databases, and supports testing, deployment, and production reliability.
Associate Software Developer building capital-markets and fixed-income web applications, developing Angular interfaces and Java/Spring Boot APIs.

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and maintain web applications supporting capital markets and fixed income using Angular and TypeScript
• Develop backend services and APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and NodeJS to support applications
• Collaborate with front office, middle office, and operations teams to gather requirements and implement feature enhancements
• Develop and integrate RESTful API with internal and external systems and relational databases
• Create UI/UX designs and prototypes using tools such as Figma
• Implement CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins
• Perform testing, debugging, and troubleshooting software applications to ensure system reliability and performance
• Participate in code reviews and follow established software development standards and best practices
• Work with cross-functional teams to deploy applications and resolve production issues

Requirements:
• Requires a Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field
• one (1) year of experience in Full-Stack Developer role within the financial services industry
• Programming using Java and Python languages
• Developing web applications using JavaScript frameworks including Angular
• Developing backend services and integrating REST APIs with relational databases
• Working in Linux environments, including configuring web servers including NGINX, and implementing CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins or GitLab
• Using version control systems such as Git and issue tracking tools such as JIRA and Confluence
• Debugging, performance tuning, and developing applications using multi-tier architecture
